title: Smoked Paprika Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 3/4 lb boneless chicken breast or thighs, sliced
For serving: tortillas, cheese, limes, cilantro
steps: In a bowl, combine the olive oil, chicken, smoked paprika, chili powder, cumin, oregano, salt, and pepper. Toss until everything is coated.
Set a skillet over high heat. Add the chicken and cook 8 to 10 minutes, until it reaches 165°F or higher.
Add the butter at the end and toss it with the chicken, then take everything off the heat.
Serve with tortillas, cheese, lime, and cilantro.

title: Ninja Creami Vanilla Ice Cream
about: Classic vanilla in the Ninja Creami.
ingredients: 1/8 tsp fine sea salt (a generous pinch)
steps: Add the milk, cream, sugar, vanilla, and salt to the Ninja Creami pint. Don't go past the max fill line.
Mix until the sugar dissolves.
Put the lid on and freeze for about 24 hours.
Spin on the Ice Cream setting. If it's crumbly, add a splash of milk and Re-spin.
Add toppings after. Use Mix-In if you want them blended in.
notes: Using 1/3 cup sugar instead of 1/2 cup makes it a little less sweet.

title: Easy Stove-Top Mac & Cheese
about: Creamy homemade mac in one pot plus a saucepan.
steps: Cook the macaroni following the package directions.
In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat. Stir in the flour and keep stirring for 3-5 minutes to make a roux.
Add the salt and pepper. Pour in the warm milk a little at a time, stirring well after each pour.
Keep cooking and stirring until it's bubbly.
Add the cheese a little at a time, stirring until it fully melts.
Drain the macaroni, add it to the cheese sauce, and stir to coat.

title: Protein Balls
notes: Makes about 12-14 balls per flavor, about 107 calories each. Double or triple a batch if you want more.

items.title: Peanut Butter
steps: Mix all the ingredients for your flavor in a big bowl until it turns into a thick, even dough.
Scoop with a tablespoon or 1-oz cookie scoop and roll into balls. Set them on a parchment-lined plate or sheet.
Chill at least 1 hour so they firm up and aren't sticky.
Store in an airtight container in the fridge. They last up to 2 weeks.

title: Ginger Immunity Boost Shot
about: Homemade wellness shot with ginger, turmeric, and pineapple.
ingredients: 1 tbsp fresh turmeric root, chopped (or 1/2 tsp ground)
1 dropper liquid echinacea or cooled echinacea tea (optional)
2-4 tbsp water (only if needed to blend)
steps: Add everything to a blender and blend until smooth. Add water only if it won't blend.
Strain through a fine mesh strainer or cheesecloth, pressing out all the liquid.
Pour into shot glasses or a small jar and keep it in the fridge.
notes: Your photo cut off the instructions, so these are the basic steps. Black pepper helps your body absorb the turmeric.

title: Mojitos
about: 8 flavors. Pick one from the dropdown.
notes: The photo only listed ingredients, so the steps use the standard mojito method: muddle, add rum and ice, top with soda.

items.title: Classic Mojito
steps: In a glass, gently muddle the mint, lime wedges, and simple syrup.
Fill with ice and add the rum.
Top with club soda, give it a gentle stir, and garnish with mint.

items.title: Mango Mojito
steps: Peel and chop the mango. Muddle or blend it with the lime juice, a little sugar, and the mint.
Add ice and the rum.
Top with club soda, give it a gentle stir, and garnish with mint.

title: Simple Lemonade
about: Fresh lemonade from 3 lemons. Makes about 4 glasses.
steps: Stir the sugar into the hot water until it dissolves and looks clear. Hot tap water works, no need to boil.
Roll the lemons on the counter, cut in half, and squeeze out the juice. Remove seeds.
In a pitcher, mix the syrup, lemon juice, and cold water.
Taste. Add water or sugar if needed. Chill 30 minutes or pour over ice.
notes: Too tart? Add a splash of water or a spoon of sugar. Too sweet? Add more lemon.

title: Crispy Air-Fryer Wings
about: Extra crispy wings in the Cuisinart air fryer, better than Wingstop.
ingredients: Aluminum-free baking powder (about 1 tsp per pound of wings)
steps: Pat the wings very dry with paper towels.
Mix the baking powder into your seasoning, then toss the wings in it before cooking.
Lay them on the rack with space between each one. Don't crowd them.
Air fry at 450°F for 20 to 25 minutes. Flip around the 10 to 12 minute mark.
Check later batches a little early, since the air fryer stays hot.
Toss in sauce after cooking, not before.
notes: Use baking powder, not baking soda (tastes off) or cornstarch (less crunchy). For 3 flavors, do batches of 8, 8, and 6. The smaller batch cooks a bit faster.

title: Crispy-Bottom Homemade Pizza
about: How to get a crispy crust with Trader Joe's dough.
steps: Preheat a pizza stone, steel, or upside-down baking sheet at 500 to 550°F for 45 to 60 minutes.
Stretch the dough thin so it doesn't steam.
Brush the bottom with a little olive oil.
Par-bake the plain dough for 3 to 4 minutes.
Add a light layer of sauce and toppings. Too much wet stuff makes it soggy.
Bake until the cheese bubbles and the bottom is browned.
notes: Most reliable trick: brown the bottom in a cast iron skillet on the stove first, then finish in the oven or under the broiler. Check the dough's use-by date. Old dough gets sticky and won't crisp.
